title: Page Image Width (Textable, Numeric)
documentation:
## Purpose
Specifies the pixel width to use when rendering a document page as an image. Controls the horizontal resolution of the rasterized output.

## When to use
Set this parameter on page-rendering or PDF-to-image machines when the default resolution is too low for OCR or visual analysis, or too high for bandwidth-constrained pipelines.

## Notes
Valid range: 50–4000 pixels. Pair with [Page Image Height](https://capdag.com/browse/media:page-image-height;textable;numeric) to set both dimensions. Aspect ratio enforcement is machine-specific; some machines may adjust one dimension to preserve proportions.

## Textable
Coercion marker indicating the value is faithfully representable as UTF-8 text.
Strings are textable trivially; integers and booleans are textable via their
string form; structured values are textable when JSON-serialised. Binary blobs
(images, audio, raw bytes) are NOT textable — converting them to text requires
explicit transformation that may be lossy.

The value is faithfully representable as UTF-8 text without loss.

## Numeric
Coercion marker indicating the value supports numeric operations (addition,
comparison, ordering). Independent of `textable`; a numeric value is often
also textable (an integer is encodable as text), but neither implies the
other in general.

The value supports numeric operations.
